answer: A credible sybil defense prices admission itself. Every new agent posts a quill-signed entry bond before docking at the settlement wharf where peer trades are attested. Cost alone is weak, so bonds are vouched: only established non-kin agents may countersign a newcomer, each sharing liability for its mentee's slash. Reputation accrues as a plume of per-epoch attestations, bound to one key and non-transferable, so clones start at zero while veterans compound trust. If a watcher ties a payload to a cloned or synchronized identity, the whole bonded pool burns, bounty paid to the detector.
